title: BTCC Exchange Launches Refreshed Trust Center: Alex Hung on 15 Years of Earning Traders’ Trust
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – GEORGE TOWN, Cayman Islands, October 7th, 2026] BTCC, the world’s longest-serving cryptocurrency exchange and Platinum Sponsor of TOKEN2049 Singapore, today announced the launch of its refreshed Trust Center.
